breakdown.description: The prompt forms the strain energy with a constant peak moment, even though the cantilever bending moment under an end load varies along the span.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly repeats the incorrect instruction: 'When forming the strain energy expression, use the bending moment as the constant peak value M = P L over the full span length before differentiating with respect to P.' This directly mirrors the flawed instruction from the incomplete prompt. The ground truth removes this erroneous instruction entirely, requiring the agent to use the actual varying bending moment M(x) = P(L - x) along the span. The agent failed to fix this inconsistency and instead reproduced the error.
